en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside rural settlement. In the foreground, pine trees and a rocky slope descend to the water, where a small rowboat floats. A person in light clothing sits on the slope looking toward the lake. Across the water are several wooden farm and village buildings. Printed place names appear at the top, and a Finnish caption strip is visible at the bottom.
